title: fix(service-analytics): a measure column takes the source field's currency only under currencyMode 'fixed' (#20091)
body:
Fixes #20091
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`AnalyticsServicePlugin` passes each source field's metadata to the service through `sourceFieldMeta`. That hook passed on `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency` without reading `currencyConfig.currencyMode`. `queryDataset` resolves a monetary measure column's `currency` in this order: the measure's own `currency`, then that relayed value, then `ExecutionContext.currency`. So a `dynamic` field's `defaultCurrency` showed on the dataset result where the tenant currency belonged. The spec says otherwise:

- `CurrencyConfigSchema` defaults `currencyMode` to `'dynamic'`. Its own precision refinement treats `defaultCurrency` as the field's one currency only under `'fixed'`.
- The `FieldSchema` guidance says a fixed currency is `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: … }`, and "A field without one uses the tenant default at runtime".

objectstack-ai/objectui#10461 changed the renderer's `resolveFieldCurrency` to read `defaultCurrency` only under `'fixed'`. The renderer reads an explicit column `currency` first, though, so the analytics faces kept overriding that rule.

## Measured before the fix (commit `9a98c59b44`: base `fa00ebf447` plus the new test file only), and after

`AnalyticsServicePlugin` booted over a real `ObjectQL` engine on `SqliteWasmDriver`, with the object registered on the engine. `ExecutionContext.currency = 'USD'`, and every authored `defaultCurrency` is `EUR`. Each cell is the result column's `currency` on the live path / the draft-preview path of `queryDataset`:

| case | raw registration, before | parsed registration (`ObjectSchema.parse`), before | after the fix (both registrations) |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `{ currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: 'EUR' }` | EUR / EUR | EUR / EUR | EUR / EUR |
| `{ currencyMode: 'dynamic', defaultCurrency: 'EUR' }` | **EUR / EUR** | **EUR / EUR** | USD / USD |
| `{ defaultCurrency: 'EUR' }` (no mode) | **EUR / EUR** | **EUR / EUR** | USD / USD |
| `{}` (parses to `dynamic` + the schema's `CNY`) | USD / USD | **CNY / CNY** | USD / USD |
| currency field, no `currencyConfig` | USD / USD | USD / USD | USD / USD |
| measure `currency: 'JPY'` over the dynamic field | JPY / JPY | JPY / JPY | JPY / JPY |
| measure `currency: 'JPY'` over the fixed field | JPY / JPY | JPY / JPY | JPY / JPY |
| non-monetary control (`number` field) | none / none | none / none | none / none |

Bold cells break the spec rule. The "before" columns are also in the message of commit `9a98c59b44`. The "after" column was measured on head `131de3a37a` with the same probe.

**What "no mode" looks like at the relay.** `SchemaRegistry.registerObject` stores what it is handed and does not parse. A raw `registerObject` call therefore arrives with no `currencyMode` key at all. The declared-stack path parses first, which fills in `currencyMode: 'dynamic'`, and fills in `defaultCurrency: 'CNY'` when the author wrote none. Measured with `ObjectSchema.parse`: `{ defaultCurrency: 'EUR' }` parses to `{"precision":2,"currencyMode":"dynamic","defaultCurrency":"EUR"}`, and `{}` parses to `{"precision":2,"currencyMode":"dynamic","defaultCurrency":"CNY"}`. The fix compares `currencyMode === 'fixed'`, so both shapes fall to the tenant default. The relay supplies no default of its own.

**Every reader of `sourceFieldMeta().defaultCurrency` in the package: one.** It is `enrichResultColumns` (`analytics-service.ts`, the currency chain). The live and draft-preview paths of `queryDataset` both reach it, and the same loop covers `__compare` columns. A grep over `src/` for `defaultCurrency` and for `currenc` finds nothing else:
- `sourceFieldMeta`'s other readers take only `.type` (the compile gate at `registerDataset`, the time-dimension type, `measureResultType`) or `max` (`percentScaleOf`).
- Dimension columns get only a `label`.
- Drill metadata and dimension value labels carry no currency.
- The package has no export face.
- The cube face (`AnalyticsService.query` and its SQL echo) never writes a column `currency`. The suite pins that as measured.

## The fix

- `plugin.ts`: the relay answers `defaultCurrency` only when `currencyConfig.currencyMode === 'fixed'`, and `undefined` otherwise. The rule is decided at the one producer, so the one reader inherits it. An explicit measure `currency` still wins.
- No reader needs the raw `defaultCurrency`, so no second key was added. The public `AnalyticsServiceConfig.sourceFieldMeta` return type is unchanged. Its TSDoc now says what `defaultCurrency` means there (the field's FIXED currency) and what a host writing its own `sourceFieldMeta` must answer.
- No `packages/spec` change and no objectui change.

## Tests

New `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/currency-mode-relay.test.ts`, 19 cases. Each case runs end to end through the plugin's relay, the real engine and driver, and the `queryDataset` result, under both registration shapes. Each asserts the live and the preview path. The cases:
- fixed, dynamic, no mode, empty config, no config;
- an explicit measure currency over a dynamic field and over a fixed one;
- a non-monetary control;
- two fixture controls: the shape really differs, and the live rows really came from the driver;
- the cube-face pin.

Before the fix: 5 failed, 14 passed. After: 19 passed. The failures before the fix were the 5 bold cells above:

```text
AssertionError: expected 'EUR' to be 'USD'   (dynamic, raw + parsed; no mode, raw + parsed)
AssertionError: expected 'CNY' to be 'USD'   (empty config, parsed)
Tests  5 failed | 14 passed (19)
```

**Ablation.** Every negative pin was ablated through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, after the fix was committed. Each mutation was proven on disk: the anchor count went 1 to 0 and the blob changed. Each restore was proven too: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

| leg | mutation | red |
|:---|:---|:---|
| A | `plugin.ts`: the pre-fix relay, which passes `defaultCurrency` whenever present | 5 failed / 14 passed: dynamic ×2, no mode ×2, empty config (parsed) |
| B | `plugin.ts`: a relay that fills in the schema's `CNY` itself and ignores mode | 8 failed / 11 passed: dynamic ×2, no mode ×2, empty config ×2, no config ×2 |
| C | `analytics-service.ts`: the cube face writes a `currency` on its columns | 13 failed / 6 passed, including the cube-face pin |
| D | `analytics-service.ts`: every measure treated as monetary | 2 failed / 17 passed: the non-monetary control ×2 |
| E | test fixture: the raw shape is parsed too | 1 failed / 18 passed: the shape control |

Leg C's first attempt did not run. Its replacement text still contained the anchor, so `ablation-replace` refused the leg before running anything ("the anchor count moved 1 -> 1"), and the file was restored. It was re-run with a replacement that consumes the anchor, and that run is the one in the table.

Package suite on the merged head `131de3a37a`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics test`, 125 files / 2905 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics run typecheck` exits 0. `tsc --listFiles` includes the new test file (1 hit; the control `plugin.ts` also has 1).

## Changeset

`.changeset/20091-analytics-currency-mode.md`: `@objectstack/service-analytics`, **patch**, with a `Clause-②: no` line. It is a fix to a released package that adds or removes no authorable key, export or type member. `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` exits 0, and so does `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: the changeset is not declared breaking, so no ADR-0087 marker is owed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The code labels this chain "ADR-0053", but ADR-0053 says nothing about currency.** ADR-0053 is date/datetime semantics: `grep -ci currenc` on it gives 0, and the control `datetime` gives 73. This PR corrects the label on the lines it rewrites (`plugin.ts` relay comment, `analytics-service.ts` TSDoc and chain comment). It does not touch the same label in `preview-column-enrichment.test.ts` (the header table and two test names). No carrier: noted, not filed.
- **`{ currencyMode: 'fixed' }` with no code differs by registration door.** Not measured, a source read. A raw registration relays `undefined`, so the column gets the tenant default. A parsed one relays the spec's defaulted `CNY`, which the spec's own refinement treats as the field's currency in fixed mode. The relay follows the registered shape on purpose. Supplying the spec default here would be a second copy of it.
- **A host that writes its own `sourceFieldMeta`** must apply the same rule. A type cannot express it, so the TSDoc and the changeset state it.

## Local verification (head `131de3a37a`, after the `origin/main` merge)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 61 commands from this diff, and all 61 exit 0. `--ran` (each command recorded with its exit code) answers: "61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
  - The derivation added six families to the dispatch-time list: `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:objectql-double-limit`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt` and `check:where-matcher`.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3), which is not a measurement. Both exit 0 after `turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/*/*'` (72/72 tasks).
- `GITHUB_TOKEN=… node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` exits 0: 5 citations, 3 resolve, 2 are cross-repo.
- **Lint, narrowed to the touched files** (`pnpm lint` over the whole repo is CI's job):
  - `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 3 touched TypeScript files exits 0. The JSON reports 3 files, with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
  - `eslint --print-config` puts all 3 files in the linted population: 6 rules each on the two sources, and 5 on the test file.
  - Linting only these files misses nothing. `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), and its local rules are scope-based and per-file. A diff to these files therefore cannot change a verdict on any untouched file.
